teacher_reference.source_note: read-only reuse of the T03 teacher-continuation verdicts; this pass issues zero teacher queries

verified_mask_census.conclusion: the corpus verified_mask verifies exactly the teacher's chosen action in every row it verifies, so it never offers the third arm WP420-02 §5 asks for; that arm is recorded as n/a

t04_two_frame_dataset.comparison_note: the census compares the verified candidate with the slot's ``chosen`` label, not with ``executed_cand``: a four-frame block verifies only the candidate the teacher chose, while the block's second two-frame slot executes the block's second sub-action

notes: the student continuation runs in role="env" because obs-v3 needs pixels and a forked child cannot produce them (evidence/T03/PILOT_COST.md §9.3); so every arm pays its own RESET plus its own prefix replay - nothing is forked and no snapshot ABI is added
one arm = RESET -> replay the recorded prefix (per-frame HASH checked) -> the candidate's two frames -> {student forward -> two frames} until the horizon, the first death or a local stage clear
the frozen student's decision rule is the frozen v4.1.0 evaluator's: argmax over the 18 move logits, bomb pinned to 0 (never actuated)
unknown never becomes engine_death and never joins a safe set: the verdicts come from contracts.classify_branch_outcome and the sets from contracts.safe_action_set

this round tests 2-4 first actions per state, not the 18 candidates, so its 'proper' count is 'among the tested arms both a death and a survival occurred', which is the quantity the teacher-continuation round scored as 0

repeat_agreement.note: the same (state, arm) run twice in the same process; the per-frame HASH trace digest and the verdict must match

summary.proper_this_round_definition: 0 < |safe set| < arms tested, i.e. among this round's 2-4 first actions at least one died and at least one survived; this is the quantity the teacher-continuation round measured as 0 of 20
summary.proper_without_unverified_filler_definit: the same count after dropping every arm whose only name is the unverified teacher-rank2 filler, so a reader can see whether the discrimination depends on it
summary.proper_18_candidate_definition: only a state whose every 18 candidates were validated can satisfy the gate's 0 < |S| < 18 definition; this pass tests 3 first actions, so this counter is 0 by construction and is never added to the gate's number

teacher_round_contrast.definition: rows = whether the teacher continuation survived all 18 candidates at the same state and horizon (T03 evidence), columns = whether this round's student continuation produced a death

repeat_agreement.note: the same (state, arm) run twice in the same process; the per-frame HASH trace digest and the verdict must match

policies.note: the teacher's recorded action is read from the corpus label, never queried, so the teacher arm is a label and the continuation is the student's

boundaries: this round tests 3-4 first actions per state, not the 18 candidates: |S| is over the tested arms

the third arm's pre-registered source (the corpus verified_mask) has no alternative candidate: every recorded row verifies exactly the teacher's chosen action, so that arm is n/a unless an engine-verified alternative from the T03 pass exists
unknown is never a death and never a survival; it is left out of the safe set and counted in unknown_arms with its reason

g420_1.informative_definition: 0 < |safe set| < arms tested, i.e. among this round's 2-4 first actions at least one died and at least one survived; this is the quantity the teacher-continuation round measured as 0 of 20
